skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Dream In A Moment
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Dream In A Moment. Two sets of clothing held in Passenger's memories and casually put to paper, then realized as outfits by a snooping Operator.
skins.usage: One of Elliot and Passenger's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Perhaps due to Old Isin's influence, on occasion both Elliot and Passenger find themselves deep in a dream—one of what is to come, the other of what has been...
